title: Location permissions warning shown when permissions granted Android 9.0
body: Every time I access settings on xDrip+ where I am given the option to enable location setting for xDrip+. However on checking the permissions are already granted. This warning seems to be triggered incorrectly.

comments.body: do you have location on? doesnt matter if you have given permissions or not that pop up seems to happen if location isnt on as i assume its not getting the data
If you have battery saver mode on or an app that tries to extend battery life, location may be aggressively turned off prompting this error.

Good evening. I've the same issue since version 20190110-14fecb8. The previous version, 20180908-d1d4887, works fine but from this ahead all of them give me this problem (nightly included). I can pair my xbridge but everytime I enter Settings or Bluetooth scan the message appears (with location on, of course). I have Android 7.0
Thank you in advance for your help.
Regards

Edit: reading some other posts I have solved the problem. Under Location, with it enabled, click Mode and select High accuracy. I hope this helps.

I've enabled the Do not keep prompting for battery optimisation and this
warning message disappears.
